method: BASELINE. scope: From the seat of the student and the former student repaying: ss 36-5, 36-10 (Commonwealth supported student); ss 90-1, 90-5, 93-1, 93-5 (the student contribution amount for a unit, by its formula), 93-10, 93-20, 96-1 (HECS-HELP); ss 104-1, 104-5 (FEE-HELP); ss 128-15, 128-20, 128-25 (HELP balance, loan limit, re-crediting on repayment); ss 137-5, 137-10, 137-19A (HELP debts, the FEE-HELP loan fee, the 2025 20% cut); ss 137-20, 140-40 (discharge on death); ss 140-5, 140-10, 140-25, 140-26, 140-30 (accumulated HELP debt by the s 140-25(1) and s 140-26(2) formulas, and indexation); ss 151-1, 151-10, 151-15 (voluntary repayment); ss 154-1, 154-5, 154-10, 154-15, 154-20, 154-25 (compulsory repayment: $67,000 minimum for 2025-26, 15%/17% marginal rates, 10% cap, thresholds indexed by the s 154-25(2) formula with AWE as an input); s 154-18(1) (notice on leaving Australia) Added 2026-10-24 (hesa-formulas.l4), from C2004A01234.formulas.md: the reduced HELP debt indexation factor (s 140-10(1A)); Part 5-6 indexation (ss 198-10, 198-15) and the HELP balance on the indexed loan limit; the repayment thresholds and compulsory repayment from AWE (ss 154-1, 154-20, 154-25); the limits in ss 36-45 and 128C-10(1)(b).
